text: Figure 3.26: The propagated local wake-up is forwarded by the neighboring PHYs as WUP to the connected ECUs (ECU2, ECU3 and Switch2) The forwarding behavior of each PHY can be modelled in the SystemT emplate. Each PHY is modelled as CouplingPort. Each CouplingPort could enable the OA TC10 compliant wake-up and sleep on dataline by defining a wakeupSleepOnDatalineConfig reference.
